candidate_windows.section_title: additional attention-head ablation experiments for stereotype detection
candidate_windows.normalized_section_title: additional attention-head ablation experiments for stereotype detection
candidate_windows.window_text:
We show the attention-head ablation results of the RoBERTa, T5-small, T5-base, Flan-T5-small, and Flan-T5-base in Figure C1. Clearly, all the performance changes are clean when the most important attention heads for stereotype detection (according to our probing results) are pruned. Except for the small numbers of very contributive attention heads, pruning other attention heads does not strongly negatively affect the performance of the stereotype

detection models. These results support the high quality of our probing results.

We use a single RTX-6000 card for all the probing experiments and GLUE evaluations. Table E1: 10 words with the highest SHAP-adjusted attention scores (ranked in order) on the top-5 contributive attention heads in T5-small, T5-base, Flan-T5-small, and Flan-T5-base models for detecting stereotypes toward 5 minority groups.
